残る remainder/stayingbehind, intentionalityundetermined. 無くなる absence/depletion/disappearance usuallykana; separate亡くなる respectfuldeath notimported as sameidentity.
取り替える replacementorreciprocalswap;をthing/にreplacement/とparticipant. 取るconnectingform+替える controlsichidan; replacement not necessarily returnedexchange.

慣れる に target/ことnominalization, familiaritynotnecessarilylikingorskill; notpassive merelyfromれる. Do not equate takinglessons with beingaccustomed. Official慣れる/馴れる spellingtendencies are not hardanimal/person classes.

最後 endpoint/lastitem; actualdictionary latest/mostrecent sense is notdenied. 先週 is previouscalendarweek, not automatically最後の週. Do not transfer最終's not-mostrecent restriction to最後.
